title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 29, 2026

A newly reported CME has Sunny checking in on the outer corona.

☀️ CME start: September 29, 2026 at 07:12 UTC
💨 CME speed: 958 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: C-type (500–999 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 10° (Narrow)
📍 Source: S09W90 (near the western limb)
🌎 WSA-ENLIL Earth outlook: No or little Earth impact modeled

Sunny is keeping watch. 👀🌌

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-2
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
